target.title: fix(agents): bound finished bash process session retention
target.body:
Closes #105625

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where long-running Gateways retaining many completed background bash/exec sessions would keep an unbounded finished-session map until TTL expiry, and session reset/delete would leave matching finished process records pollable until that TTL. That multiplies retained aggregate output and can grow gateway heap under bursty shell workloads.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep completed `process poll` / `process log` aggregates (ClawSweeper rejected tail-only retention), but enforce deterministic finished-session count and total-aggregate-byte caps, and purge finished records whose `scopeKey` matches gateway session lifecycle cleanup keys. Shared scopes (for example chat bash) are not purged when an unrelated agent session resets.

## User Impact

Operators get bounded finished-process memory growth under heavy background exec traffic. Resetting or deleting a gateway session no longer leaves that session’s finished process records pollable until job TTL. Completed process log/poll behavior for still-retained sessions is unchanged.

## Evidence

Verification host: local macOS (Crabbox bypass)

Focused tests (pass):
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-process-registry.test.ts` — 18 passed
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/session-reset-cleanup.test.ts` — 7 passed
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.process.poll-timeout.test.ts` — 8 passed

Static:
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check` on touched files — pass
- `git diff --check` — pass

Closeout note: `pnpm check:changed` reported a pre-existing TypeScript LOC ratchet failure on many unrelated main-tree paths; not introduced by this change. Touched-surface proof is the focused Vitest + oxfmt path above.

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: Finished bash process sessions are no longer retained without a count/byte bound, and session reset/delete purges finished records for matching lifecycle scopes while preserving aggregate logs for still-retained entries.
- Environment: local macOS Darwin arm64, openclaw checkout on branch `fix/105625-bash-finished-session-bounds` at base `1aff6da82`, Node via repo Vitest wrappers.
- Current-main contrast: On main, `pruneFinishedSessions` only deletes by TTL; `finishedSessions` has no count/byte cap; `clearSessionResetRuntimeState` does not touch finished process records, so scoped finished sessions remain until TTL.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-process-registry.test.ts -t "evicts the oldest finished session when the count cap is exceeded"`
  2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-process-registry.test.ts -t "evicts oldest finished sessions when retained aggregate bytes exceed the cap"`
  3. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/session-reset-cleanup.test.ts -t "purges finished bash process records scoped to the reset session keys"`
- Evidence after fix (transcript excerpts):
  - Count cap: `✓ evicts the oldest finished session when the count cap is exceeded` (retained mid+new, dropped old)
  - Byte cap: `✓ evicts oldest finished sessions when retained aggregate bytes exceed the cap` (only newest 20-char aggregate retained under 30-char total cap)
  - Scope purge: `✓ purges finished bash process records scoped to the reset session keys` (`finishedProcessSessionsCleared === 1`, shared `chat:bash` retained)
- Control check: Registry tests still pass existing retention/output-cap cases; scope purge only matches exact `scopeKey` values and leaves unscoped + alternate-scope finished sessions; aggregate field remains on retained finished records (not tail-only).
- Observed result after fix: Oldest finished sessions are evicted under count and total-aggregate caps; session reset cleanup removes only matching-scope finished process records and reports `finishedProcessSessionsCleared`.
- What was not tested: Live gateway heap OOM stress under production load; full `pnpm check` / full suite; live multi-tenant session reset via Control UI (covered at unit/source level via `clearSessionResetRuntimeState`).

## AI disclosure

This fix was authored with AI assistance (Grok). Implementation and proof follow ClawSweeper guidance on #105625 (count-plus-byte retention + scope-keyed cleanup; keep completed aggregates).
